_about: How to drive the LIVE bulk-offer app to each screen worth filming. Run against a preexisting running worktree: node src/capture.mjs --pr-dir prs/pr-618 --base-url <url>. Selectors use the PR's own data-testid hooks. Shots needing a seeded message / login take values from the environment (e.g. BULK_MSG_ID, MOD_MSG_URL). Authored from the live clearance.vue / BulkItemEditor.vue / BulkItemsInterest.vue + the PR's test flows; verify on first live capture (the bulk-offer branch is still WIP).

shots._note2: addItem() unshifts (prepends) a row, so always fill the TOP row (index 0) and add items in REVERSE display order — the row meant for the bottom first.
